name: Suzanne Marie Doucinet

events.title: Marriage to Daniel Mercereau
events.description: By Pierre Peiret after banns on three Sundays; Daniel of the bourg of Moëze in Saintonge, she of the city of La Rochelle. Marks/signatures of 'the sieur Doucinet', D. Mercereau, Elisabet Dubois (mark), Marie Mercereau (mark), Suzanne Doucinet (mark), Susanne Ratier, Josué Mercereau, Elie Masse, Pierre Masse, Ezechiel Grazillier, Jean La Tourette, René Rezeau.

bioAdditions: Suzanne Marie Doucinet, of La Rochelle, married Daniel Mercereau of Moëze in Saintonge at the French Church of New York on Sunday 6 Aug 1693. The register carries the mark of 'the sieur Doucinet' and that of Elisabet Dubois, the groom's mother, among the witnesses (S1). The sieur Doucinet was probably Estienne Dousinet, a shoemaker of New York who appears as a sponsor in the same register. Earlier that summer (25 Jun 1693) 'Marie Susanne Doucinet' had been godmother, with Jean La Tourette, to Pierre, son of Pierre Masse and Elisabet Mercereau, and she could only make her mark (S1). Children baptized: Daniel (b. 10 Aug 1695, bapt. 18 Aug 1695, sponsors Pierre Masse and Judy Pare), Susanne Marie (b. 8 Jul 1697, bapt. 18 Jul 1697) and Marianne (b. 31 Oct 1699, bapt. 5 Nov 1699, sponsors Joshue Mercereau and Jeanne Jamain) (S1).
